_comment: Download links for the site's Download page, kept as data so publishing a
new build is editing this file rather than editing a page template.
'base' is prepended to any 'file' that is not already a full URL. Point it
at a GitHub release (recommended: direct links, no interstitial, versioned,
2 GB per file) or at any other host.
Set 'file' to null for a platform that has not been published yet; the page
then shows it as built-and-tested but not yet downloadable, rather than
'notice' is shown above the table -- use it for a host-specific caveat, e.g. Google Drive showing a virus-scan warning on files over 100 MB.

platforms.name: Windows x64
platforms.note: Windows 10 or later. Use Extract All, then run FEAST.exe.

platforms.name: macOS (Apple Silicon)
platforms.note: M1 and later. tar -xzf, then right-click FEAST.app and choose Open.

platforms.name: macOS (Intel)
platforms.note: tar -xzf, then right-click FEAST.app and choose Open.

notice: These builds are hosted on Google Drive while a permanent home is set up. Drive cannot virus-scan files this large, so it shows a warning page first — choose Download anyway. For the same reason curl and wget will fetch that warning page rather than the file; use a browser.
